About This Job
We’re looking for a Legal Advisor to join our team, supporting a broad range of legal matters across our UK business. Working closely with our Senior Legal Manager, you’ll gain exposure to everything from commercial real estate and contracts to construction, debt recovery, ESG and corporate governance. Please note that this is a 12-month FTC
What you’ll be doing
You’ll act as a key legal contact for designated centres across the UK and Canada, partnering with colleagues across the business and working with external legal advisers when required.
Your role will include:
• Managing commercial real estate matters, with a particular focus on leasing and asset management transactions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts for goods and services, including facilities and marketing-related agreements.
• Supporting our property management and development teams on enhancement and construction projects, including construction contracts, professional appointments and planning matters.
• Managing and advising on UK debt recovery and insolvency matters, taking a practical and commercially focused approach to resolving disputes.
• Supporting legal matters relating to our ESG strategy, corporate governance, data protection, anti-bribery and risk management activities.
• Working closely with external solicitors, providing clear instructions and monitoring the progress of matters.
• Providing practical, commercially minded legal advice and research on a variety of ad hoc matters across the business.
• Supporting legal reporting, records and trackers, as well as helping to prepare and deliver training to colleagues across the business.
For more information, please refer to the full job description

Qualifications
We’re looking for someone who is:
• A qualified lawyer with 0–2 years’ PQE.
• Experienced within private practice and/or an in-house legal environment.
• Commercially minded, with the ability to balance legal considerations with business needs.
• Organised and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work to challenging deadlines.
• Analytical with strong problem-solving skills and excellent attention to detail.
• A confident communicator, able to build effective relationships with colleagues and external advisers.
• A collaborative team player who is equally comfortable taking ownership of their own work.
• Confident using Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.

Additional Information
• Competitive Salary & Bonus: Enjoy a competitive salary with a performance bonus of up to 25%.
• Wellbeing Allowance: Claim towards yoga, gym equipment, or any activity that promotes your wellbeing.
• Volunteering Days: Benefit from 2 paid volunteering days per year.
• Exclusive Discounts: Access special discounts at our Designer Outlets.
• International Exposure: Work with colleagues across eight countries within a global organization.
• Learning & Development: Access LinkedIn Learning from day one with over 16,000 courses available. Grow through internal moves, cross-country projects, international secondments, and a calendar of core development opportunities.
• Values-Based Culture: Thrive in an inclusive and collaborative environment where we value excellence, innovation, and making a difference.
• Positive Work Environment: Over 89% of our colleagues would recommend us as a great place to work, according to our latest internal engagement survey.
At McArthurGlen, we value diversity and believe that everyone is extraordinary in their own way. We are an inclusive employer and support flexible working wherever possible.
Even if you are not sure you fit all the requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you. There may be another opportunity within McArthurGlen that is more suitable for you now or in the future.
The compensation offered will depend on demonstrated skills, experience, and location. We believe in transparency. Our pay ranges are based on market benchmarks and internal equity, ensuring equitable compensation for equivalent skill levels across roles.
We're committed to creating an inclusive recruitment experience for everyone. If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know. About This Job
🚀 Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit! 🚀Provide technical expertise across the lifecycle of Electrical Systems for the SMR nuclear power plant. This covers the delivery of the complete design of the Electrical systems, spanning system architecture, sub-system design and equipment specification and design / selection to realise the final verified design of the power station. You will do this by working closely with the engineering teams from across the power station and applying a structured systems engineering approach to design.
Your mission:
• Reviews and agrees high level electrical requirements including their testability.
• Analyses and translates high level requirements into a validated design for the electrical system/component.
• Captures applicable design constraints (must meet conditions) and quality attributes (may be traded) that apply to the system/component.
• Captures requirements/constraints in line with the project’s processes for management of interfaces and requirements (e.g., requirements captured in IBM DOORS).
• Designs and implements electrical designs to meet design inputs.
• Works with the Verification team to define verification activities.
• Analyses electrical designs for functional behaviour, which may include modelling and simulation to demonstrate that the design meets the high-level requirements. Develops and reviews electrical tests that will provide evidence to demonstrate that the electrical requirements have been satisfied.
• Participates in and supports capacity planning and the development of long-term strategic goals for the team, in conjunction with managers.
• Identifies and mitigates risks.
• Develops, implements, documents, and maintains policies, procedures, associated guidelines, tools, and training as required.
• Develops the knowledge required to provide advice / support to project teams and / or integrated product teams (IPT).
• Represents the electrical engineering area in meetings, working groups and integrated project teams as assigned.
• Works across the power station engineering teams, where required, to deliver standardisation and a commoditised approach to system and component development.
• Ensures that quality is maintained throughout the SMR project lifecycle by undertaking appropriate technical reviews and providing the required electrical engineering inputs to the project technical review gates.
• Discusses the electrical system design with external organisations including the nuclear safety regulator, potential customers, and suppliers.
Why Join the Community of Switchers?
• 🌟 Over 55 years in nuclear engineering.
• 🏆 Ranked among the top 3 largest nuclear engineering companies.

• 📚 Ongoing training with numerous career opportunities.

• 🏠 Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

Qualifications
• Hold a degree level qualification in electrical engineering or a related subject.
• Experienced in working in a highly regulated industry
• Ability to travel Assystem offices and customer sites within UK.
• BPSS and SC required

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must meet UK security clearance criteria.

About This Job
Anticipated Contract End Date/Length: 6 months
Work Set Up: Remote (100% remote)
Our client in the Information Technology and Services industry is looking for a Senior DevOps / Automation Engineer (IBM Z & Hybrid Platform) to lead automation and DevOps modernisation across IBM Z and distributed platforms. This role will involve designing and implementing production-grade automation, CI/CD pipelines, compliance controls, observability solutions, and secure orchestration capabilities across a global enterprise environment.
The ideal candidate will bring extensive DevOps engineering experience, strong technical leadership skills, and hands-on expertise in enterprise automation and platform integration. The successful candidate will drive engineering best practices, strengthen governance and compliance, and mentor engineers in delivering resilient, secure, auditable, and scalable automation solutions across complex enterprise environments.
Responsibilities
• Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, conduct design reviews, and promote DevOps engineering best practices.
• Design and develop production-grade automation using Python and YAML, incorporating testing, logging, error handling, and operational resilience.
• Develop and maintain enterprise-scale automation workflows using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) across IBM Z and distributed platforms.
• Build idempotent, restartable, and state-aware workflows with appropriate failure handling, retry logic, and operational safeguards.
• Develop and maintain GitHub workflows and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, including Groovy-based pipeline development and Git-based release practices.
• Integrate automated compliance checks, quality gates, evidence capture, and artefact management through Nexus Repository or equivalent tools.
• Design and optimise PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and automation state tracking to support operational reliability and audit requirements.
• Develop Grafana dashboards and observability pipelines, integrating logging and metrics with enterprise monitoring platforms such as Splunk.
• Implement secure secrets management using HashiCorp Vault, applying least-privilege principles and integrating secure credentials into CI/CD and AAP workflows.
• Design and maintain REST API integrations and enterprise service interfaces.
• Support configuration drift detection, automated remediation, compliance governance, and secure engineering standards.
• Document reusable automation patterns and operational procedures, collaborate across mainframe and infrastructure teams, and support risk, audit, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications
• At least 10 years of demonstrable DevOps engineering experience, including solution design, governance, compliance, and implementation of DevOps best practices.
• A minimum of 2 years of experience working within an IBM Z environment.
• Strong technical leadership experience, including mentoring engineers, providing technical guidance, and promoting engineering excellence.
• Hands-on experience with GitHub, Jenkins, Ansible Automation Platform (AAP), Nexus Repository, Python, HashiCorp Vault, and API integration.
• Strong Python development skills, including production-quality code, testing, logging, error handling, and modular design.
• Experience with Jenkins pipeline development using Groovy, Git-based CI/CD practices, and YAML automation.
• Practical knowledge of PostgreSQL schema design, query optimisation, and operational data management.
• Experience developing Grafana dashboards and supporting monitoring, metrics, and observability initiatives.
• Knowledge of secure secrets management, credential lifecycle management, compliance verification, and configuration drift management.
• Familiarity with IBM Z and z/OS concepts, including JCL and batch scheduling.
• Ability to design resilient, restartable automation workflows and operate effectively in complex enterprise environments.
• Strong documentation, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage technical, infrastructure, risk, and audit stakeholders.
• Experience in regulated financial services environments is preferred.
• Familiarity with IBM z/OSMF and zOAU is highly advantageous; experience with IWS, Infrastructure-as-Code governance, and observability tooling is desirable.

You will connect diverse scientific data with business and R&D decision-making, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to generate robust insights and accelerate complex decisions. About This Job
We’re looking for a creative copywriter to join our growing integrated marketing team, working across both the LOD & SYKE brands to create compelling marketing copy for our customers and partners. They will write engaging, thought-provoking, B2B and B2C marketing content for a legal audience.
On a day-to-day basis you can expect to spend your time writing:
• Case studies – working from a detailed brief to create compelling success stories
• Thought piece articles – deliver original and thought-provoking opinion pieces from the point of view of senior leaders with different tones of voice, based on written briefs or conversations with senior leaders
• Monthly client emails as part of an ongoing cross and upsell nurture programme. Monthly prospect emails to generate new business leads.
• Suites of organic LinkedIn posts to promote a particular service line, educating clients and prospects and encouraging them to consider us. Including post copy and headlines for supporting visuals/animations.
• Client, partner and prospect facing sales materials across a range of service lines such as short brochures, toolkits and snapshot one-pagers.
• Tone of Voice development – assist in the development and evolution of the SYKE TOV and apply this to future content pieces, including how the TOV aligns with LOD

Qualifications
We’d like you to have the following:
• 5 years of B2B copywriting experience with examples that lean towards B2C in tone (we’re not stuffy or corporate). Legal, professional services or a tech background a bonus
• Impeccable written English skills
• Ability to write in various tones of voice based on author personas
• Quick to digest information and able to explain complex technical concepts in plain English
• Some experience in creative concepting for digital ads (not essential)
Who are LOD & SYKE?
LOD & SYKE are companies within the LOD Group who share a set of values and ambitions across the two brands. Although they are distinct entities, they work closely together to help their customers with all their legal operations, tech and people needs.
LOD was set up 15 years ago to make the lives of lawyers better and that is still at the centre of everything we do today. We match lawyers and other legal professionals with companies who need legal expertise in-house, giving them an alternative way of working other than in big law firms. They get more flexibility, more interesting opportunities, and more fulfilling work, with none of the drudgery of the magic circle firms. The companies get access to cream of the crop lawyers in a way that suits them; they can choose from individual lawyers, teams who can be parachuted in, or legal specialists who fix broken processes, or any combination of the above.
SYKE was founded in 2016 to help corporate legal teams choose, buy and implement legal tech. We support our customers, who are predominantly legal teams within enterprise corporate businesses, to modernise their operations through process improvements and bespoke tech solutions. About This Job
About the Role
Reporting to the Head of DevOps, you'll provide technical leadership across cloud infrastructure, platform engineering and automation while staying hands-on in delivery. The Head of DevOps owns the overall function and people leadership across our UK and Pune capabilities. You'll be the senior technical leader, working alongside the engineers.
You won't lead from the sidelines. You'll be in the infrastructure, pipelines and code alongside the team, shaping our DevOps practice and turning good engineering principles into solutions that work in production.
You'll design and evolve secure, scalable and cost-effective infrastructure, keeping our platforms reliable, observable and efficient. Working with engineering, security and product teams, you'll take difficult technical challenges from design through to a stable production outcome.
If you want real technical depth with genuine leadership, where you can set direction and still know what's happening under the hood, this is built for you.
What You'll Do
• Own our AWS and Azure infrastructure. You'll set practical standards for security, reliability, scalability, performance, compliance, cost and resource use, working with architects, developers, security and product teams to ensure they work in the real world.
• Write and maintain the Terraform that runs our infrastructure. Build reusable modules, manage state and environments, and keep documentation up to date. Use the consoles to diagnose problems, but make lasting changes through code, review and controlled deployment.
• Get hands-on with our CircleCI pipelines, creating standards practical enough to be adopted, not simply written down. Embed secret detection, dependency and container scanning, software bills of materials, code-quality checks and supply-chain controls, then help teams fix the risks that matter.
• Run our production Kubernetes platforms day-to-day, working directly with Argo CD, Helm and container tooling to deploy, upgrade, optimise and troubleshoot.
• Keep a close eye on availability, performance and resource consumption. Improve metrics, logs, dashboards and alerts so the team can spot trouble coming. When something goes wrong, lead the technical response, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
• Ensure we can recover as effectively as we can run. Help maintain and test our backup, resilience and disaster-recovery arrangements, using Python or Bash to remove repetitive work and improve consistency.
• Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews and hands-on problem-solving. Spread knowledge, share responsibility and avoid creating reliance on a single person.
• Stay curious. Run technical spikes and bring evidence when you think we should change direction. Be the practical bridge between engineering, security, product and the wider business, grounded in what you're building and running.
What We're Looking For
•  You've run production cloud infrastructure in practice, with deep expertise in AWS or Azure and confidence in the other. You're comfortable in the console and in the code, and you understand networking, identity, security controls and governance.
• You've built reusable Terraform module catalogues, managed remote state, and supported multiple environments, accounts, or subscriptions through reviewed and controlled changes.
•  Your Kubernetes experience is production-focused: deployments, upgrades, troubleshooting, and capacity and performance. You've used Helm and GitOps day-to-day, with direct Argo CD experience strongly preferred.
• You've designed CI/CD pipelines from scratch and implemented DevSecOps controls yourself, including secrets detection, dependency and container scanning, SBOM generation, and software supply-chain security.
•  You use Python or Bash regularly and can demonstrate tooling you've developed and maintained. You understand observability, incident response, root-cause analysis and production reliability.
•  You've helped engineers grow through collaboration and shared problem-solving. You lead by example and clearly explain technical risks, options and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Desirable Experience
• Terragrunt.
• CircleCI.
• Cloud cost optimisation and FinOps practices.
• Designing and testing backup, resilience and disaster-recovery solutions.
• Working within a geographically distributed engineering team.

Additional Information
We pride ourselves in offering an excellent benefits package, including an above average pension scheme. When you join the team at NEC Software Solutions, you are provided with the following:
• Private Medical Cover funded by NEC for Employees (with the option to add family members at an additional cost)
• 25 days paid holiday with the option to buy/sell (FTE)
• 4 x basic salary life assurance cover funded by NEC (with the option to increase cover at an additional cost)
• A Group Pension Plan with fantastic employer contributions up to a maximum of 8.5%
• A selection of flexible benefits to suit your individual needs
• All colleagues get free access to LinkedIn Learning. Over 15000 courses covering a huge breadth of subjects. Learn about what you like, when you like, how you like.
OTHER INFORMATION

We are looking for a strategically-minded Lead Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. This role is centered on owning reporting and deepening our understanding of what actually drives marketing growth, while helping the wider team pursue the opportunities and gaps that matter most.
You'll focus on surfacing strategic opportunities from our Marketing Financials process and making them accessible for action across our analytics and marketing context. By using and streamlining emerging technologies and AI in the team, you will play an important role in the technical engine and processes that turn complex data into central resources, insights and clear prioritisation.

Impact-Driven Delivery: Balance technical rigor with speed to deliver meaningful data products that translate complex growth drivers into clear business impact.

•
Successfully collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics and Regional teams, acting as the crucial bridge between identifying data-driven opportunities and executing them within the wider marketing context.

Be a subject matter expert on technical infrastructure within the Marketing Analytics team, ensuring our systems are optimized for driver analysis and explanation rather than just standard reporting.

Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced Python is required.

Experience with modern data stacks, including dbt, data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake), and visualization/semantic layers like Lightdash or Looker.

Proven competencies in identifying analytical opportunities within financial/marketing processes and reporting on them effectively
•
Strong ability to understand the underlying mechanics of marketing to ensure technical products are meaningful and focused on explaining growth drivers.

A focus on building systems and automated insights that drive measurable improvements in how the business understands and acts upon data.

Experience and interest in project management, ways of working improvements and enabling wider teams in efficient collaboration.

Are you passionate about turning complex data challenges into clear, scalable product solutions?
Do you enjoy leading through ambiguity, shaping roadmaps, and helping teams deliver high-quality outcomes in an evolving AI-enabled environment?
About our Team
DBS Product Management is a newly established team focused on products and data products. Our vision is a future where every colleague has trustworthy data they confidently use to streamline processes, drive smarter decisions and accelerate growth. We identify the products and data products that matter most to Elsevier and shape what they look like.
The Enterprise Product Hub (EPH) is central to that vision. It masters Elsevier’s saleable product data in a single governed model and publishes it to around thirty systems across the business. With books and journals established, the priority now is bringing digital products to the same standard as Elsevier transforms how it sells and invoices its products.
About the Role
The Senior Data Product Manager owns an evolving area of the EPH product estate – the attributes that enable us to sell a product, from what it’s called to how it’s identified and how it’s sold. You will report to the Head of Product Data.
This role complements the existing product management by taking responsibility for a current gap in our data estate: the ingestion and publication of digital product data. It is a greenfield build with no agreed blueprint. You will work with the business to define what digital product data should be (what it covers, who relies on it, what good looks like), then shape and deliver the digital product lifecycle solution that publishes it across A&G, Health and Corporate Markets, alongside the existing books and journals data.
This is a delivery-first role: you will work closely with EPH business and engineering colleagues and represent EPH's position in cross-team decisions, with a meaningful second strand; coaching and growing the analysts around you.
Your success will be measured by the quality of the decisions you make under ambiguity, the analysts you grow, and – above all – the extent to which the product data you own helps Elsevier go to market more effectively and makes the customer buying experience better.
Responsibilities
• Partner with commercial, finance and digital product teams to define the products and data products they need: scope, consumers, quality and success measures.
• Bring structure to unclear problems: frame the question, test assumptions with the business, make the call and record the rationale so others can follow it.
• Own your product area’s roadmap and success measures, making prioritisation and scope calls based on business value to Elsevier as a whole.
• Build strong relationships across business and engineering teams, and drive consumer adoption through governance, guidance and clear data documentation.
• Write clear, testable specifications up front, from concept to live release, as the team moves to Spec-Driven, AI-assisted delivery.
• Coach and develop junior and mid-level analysts, support onboarding and contribute to recruitment.
Requirements
• A passion for maximising business value, and the judgement to own a product end-to-end, making prioritisation and scope calls from incomplete information.
• Experience defining a product or data product – its consumers, scope, quality expectations and measures of success – and working directly with business teams as a partner, not a service.
• Proven senior stakeholder management experience across business and engineering teams in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
• Experience writing clear, well-constrained requirements and specifications, and genuine interest in adapting your practice to AI-assisted delivery methods.
• Knowledge of data management practices, ideally master data management (MDM), data governance and metadata management; MDM platform or academic publishing experience is advantageous.
• Demonstrated experience coaching and developing junior or mid-level analysts, ideally alongside product management or product owner experience.
Work in a way that works for you
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. PIB Group is a fast-growing, specialist insurance intermediary and distribution consolidator. We're looking for a Group Technical Accounting Manager to lead and coordinate technical accounting matters across the Group, providing subject-matter expertise on complex accounting areas, supporting high-quality Group and holding company financial reporting, and acting as a key point of contact for auditors and advisers on technical issues. •
Own the Group's technical accounting policies (IFRS and relevant UK GAAP/Companies Act requirements), ensuring consistent application across entities, and prepare technical papers for management, auditors and the Board on complex or judgemental areas.

Lead acquisition accounting for business combinations (intangibles, contingent consideration, goodwill) and advise on Group restructurings, legal entity rationalisations and intra-group transfers, including common-control and capital reorganisation transactions.
•
Own the effective interest rate (EIR) models for Group debt — including debt modifications, PIK options and other complex terms — and oversee accounting for intercompany loans and balances, including alignment with Treasury systems (e.g. Kyriba) and automation of interest calculations.
•
Oversee the Group's foreign exchange accounting (functional currency assessments, translation of foreign operations, FX hedge accounting) and IFRS 16 lease models and processes, including use of CCH Tagetik or similar tools.

Own the accounting for share-based payment schemes under IFRS 2 (management incentive plans, options, equity/cash-settled awards), ensuring appropriate charge recognition and clear disclosure of schemes, assumptions and sensitivities.
•
Lead the Group's implementation of IFRS 18 — impact assessment, policy development and changes to primary statements and notes — and support preparation and review of Group and holding company statutory financial statements.
What we're looking for:
•
Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA or equivalent) with strong post-qualification experience in technical accounting, ideally from a large practice (audit/technical advisory) and/or a complex, multi-entity Group environment.
•
Deep, hands-on experience in several of: business combinations and acquisition accounting; complex debt and EIR calculations; FX and consolidation of international operations; share-based payments (IFRS 2) and IFRS 16 leasing; Group restructurings and intra-group transactions.
•
Strong understanding of IFRS and UK Companies Act requirements; exposure to UK GAAP/FRC guidance is a plus.
•
Proven experience working directly with auditors and external advisers on complex transactions and models.
•
Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple complex workstreams under tight deadlines.

Strong communicator who can explain technical issues clearly to non-specialists, prepare concise technical papers, and collaborate across Group finance, treasury, tax, legal and local finance teams.

Registered Nurse - Renal Dialysis Unit
Are you an NMC Registered Nurse seeking an exciting new opportunity to learn specialist skills in renal dialysis nursing?
You may have NHS experience or have worked in the private care sector, but whatever your Nursing background, with the right attitude and aptitude we have an opportunity for you!
What does the role involve?
Being a Dialysis nurse requires commitment and passion along with the skills and competencies to juggle the technical nursing aspect whilst giving holistic care.  You will be working autonomously, responsible for the assessment of care needs and the development, implementation and evaluation of care for dialysis patients with chronic kidney disease or acute kidney injury.
Carmarthen Unit operates 30 haemodialysis stations, serving up to 120 patients.
This is a full time role of 37.5 hours a week. Current days are working various shifts between 06.30am to 17.30pm Monday to Saturday.
What can we offer you?
Here at Fresenius Medical Care we provide excellent and continuous Training and Development throughout your career, supported by dedicated Clinical Teachers. On joining, you will enroll on our 8 week Fundamental Dialysis Programme, which is accredited by the European Dialysis and Transplant Nurses Association/European Renal Care Association.  Thereafter, we continue to provide training and education opportunities which significantly exceed the CPD hours required for NMC revalidation, and help take your career to the next level.
We offer a competitive salary UPTO £35,000 - Progression through the pay scale will be underpinned by a Knowledge and Skills Framework (KSF) for each role, allowing employees greater career development potential, aligned to in-house training programmes.
Alongside this we offer a wealth of other fantastic benefits listed below:
•            No Sunday or Night Shift Working
•            Company Pension Scheme and Life Assurance
•            33 Days Holiday (inclusive of 8 days bank holiday) increasing with service
•            Christmas Day and New Year’s Day off
•            Overtime (time and a half after completing full-time hours – 150 hours every 4 weeks)
•            Paid Breaks
•            Free Parking, Uniform, Tea & Coffee, Flu Vaccine and Christmas Meal
•            Health Shield – Company paid Health Cash Plan
•            Long Service Vouchers
•            Refer a Friend Scheme (£1000 per referral if successful)
•            Sick Pay
•            Cycle to Work Scheme
•            Sponsorship for training where applicable for career development
•            bhsf RISE - our Health and Wellbeing hub with 24/7 access to GP’s and Counsellors
•            Blue Light Card - discounts online and in-store.
Who is Fresenius Medical Care?
We are the leading provider of dialysis services to the NHS, operating 52 partnership dialysis units that together provide regular dialysis treatment to over 3,800 NHS patients in the UK.  We are part of a global company treating over 344,000 patients worldwide across over 4,100 clinics.
We also operate 42 production sites on all continents to provide dialysis products such as dialysis machines, dialysers and related disposables. 1 in every 2 of all dialysis machines used around the globe are manufactured by Fresenius Medical Care and we are the 3rd largest medical devices company in the world.
For more information please visit Fresenius Medical Care’s provider website: www.nephrocare.co.uk
We are a growing and ambitious company who invests in talent and creates an environment where you can grow too.  Come on our journey with us, see your skills develop and be rewarded for the exceptional care you give!

upp.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/upp-careers/jo.description_excerpt:
UPP is the UK’s leading provider of on-campus residential and academic accommodation infrastructure, operating across a diverse portfolio of university partnerships. We are passionate about creating exceptional places for students to live and learn, supported by commercial decisions that are informed by high-quality data, insight and relevant market intelligence.
We are looking for a Senior Revenue and Insights Manager to join our Partnerships team and lead UPP’s portfolio-wide approach to revenue optimisation, pricing, forecasting and commercial insight.
Working closely with the Commercial Sales and Revenue Director and key stakeholders across the business, you will translate complex data and market trends into clear, actionable recommendations. Your insight will support occupancy growth, optimise income and strengthen commercial and strategic decision-making across the portfolio.
This role is based at our award-winning London office near London Bridge, Cannon Street and Monument stations and offers hybrid working with 3 days a week in the office. Some travel and overnight stays may be required.
Key responsibilities will include:
• Lead portfolio-wide revenue management and pricing activity, developing frameworks that optimise occupancy and revenue performance.
• Lead annual rent-setting recommendations and supporting analysis.
• Own occupancy and revenue forecasting, continually improving forecast accuracy and model performance.
• Develop pricing scenarios, segmentation strategies and revenue recommendations to support business planning and university partner discussions.
• Lead competitor benchmarking and market monitoring across all operating regions.
• Analyse student demand, booking behaviour, price sensitivity, product preferences and emerging market trends.
• Develop live commercial dashboards, executive reporting and market intelligence updates.
• Lead weekly and monthly revenue and trading reviews, translating performance and forecast variances into clear commercial actions.
• Work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Accommodation Services, Finance, ICT and Data teams to improve commercial performance and reporting capability.
• Provide analytical support for new partnerships, bids, investment opportunities and strategic commercial initiatives.
• Present data-led recommendations to senior executives, university partners and boards.
We are looking for you to have significant experience in revenue management, commercial analytics, pricing or business intelligence, with:
• Strong forecasting, scenario modelling and quantitative analysis skills.
• Proven experience of using data and insight to influence commercial decisions.
• Revenue management and pricing expertise, supported by strong commercial and financial judgement.
• Experience creating executive-level reporting and presenting clear, evidence-based recommendations.
• Advanced Excel and business intelligence capability.
• The ability to translate complex data into accessible insight and practical commercial actions.
• Strong market analysis and commercial performance management experience.
• Confidence engaging with and influencing senior stakeholders.
• A collaborative, inclusive and outcome-focused approach.
Experience gained within hospitality, hotels, airlines, travel, ecommerce, retail, purpose-built student accommodation or another revenue-led environment would be advantageous. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, predictive analytics or revenue optimisation methodologies would also be beneficial.
Alongside your technical expertise, you will be a strategic and innovative thinker who is comfortable working through ambiguity, driving change and operating at pace. You will have the confidence to build analytical capability and embed data-led decision-making across the wider commercial function.
In return, we are offering a competitive salary and a great benefits package, including a discretionary performance bonus, 29 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, private healthcare, pension, enhanced family leave, life assurance, training, two paid volunteering or personal development days and a cycle-to-work scheme.
UPP welcomes all applications and recognises the value of having a diverse and inclusive culture that reflects the communities we work with and positively impacts our people, student residents and university partners.
We understand that all disabilities, impairments and conditions are unique, so please let us know about any adjustments that would support you through our recruitment process and help you thrive at work.
Our core values of Innovation, Sustainability, Community, Partnership and Respect are fundamental to our culture and reflect what is important to our business and our people.
We are a team with energy, pace and passion. Apply today and help shape the commercial insight and revenue strategies that will support UPP’s future performance and growth.

Position Description
We are hiring for a Trade Surveillance, Futures Compliance role responsible for monitoring trading activity across LME and ICE Futures Europe products using Nasdaq SMARTS to detect potential market abuse and rule breaches. The role involves analysing alerts with strong market insight, incorporating trading patterns, e-communications, and external market context to assess risk. You will support escalation processes and regulatory reporting, including STOR assessments under UK MAR, while maintaining clear and audit-ready documentation. The position also contributes to ongoing surveillance enhancement through model calibration, data quality oversight, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaboration with Compliance, Risk, and Front Office stakeholders is key to ensuring effective governance and adherence to regulatory standards.
Key Areas of Responsibilities
• Trade Surveillance Using Nasdaq SMARTS. Perform daily market‑abuse surveillance using the Nasdaq SMARTS platform across LME and ICE Futures Europe products, reviewing automated alerts for potential indicators of market manipulation, insider dealing, and other abusive behaviours and exchanges rules breaches.
• Alert Investigation and Analysis. Analyse alerts applying sound judgement to distinguish genuine risk from false positives.
• Market Context and Product Expertise. Apply strong understanding of commodities market structure, relevant to LME and ICE Futures Europe contracts when assessing alerts.
• Escalation and Suspicious Transaction and Order Report (STOR) support. Escalate suspicious activity in line with internal governance procedures, supporting Compliance with documentation, investigation summaries, and input to STOR assessments under UK MAR.
• E‑Communications Surveillance. Review and investigate audio and electronic communications alerts (email, voice, chat platforms) in coordination with trade alerts, focusing on potential misuse of inside information, market manipulation intent, or improper information sharing.
• Cross‑Product and Cross‑Source Analysis. Correlate trading behaviour with e‑communications, market news, physical market events, and position data to conduct holistic investigations, particularly for intra‑group and cross‑border trading activity.
• Calibration Feedback and Model Improvement. Provide qualitative feedback on alert performance, contributing to SMARTS calibration, back‑testing, and periodic review exercises, and any ad hoc projects.
• Data Quality and Surveillance Integrity. Identify potential data quality, timeliness, or completeness issues impacting surveillance effectiveness and work with Technology, Operations, or Compliance to resolve surveillance‑relevant data concerns.
• Documentation and Audit‑Readiness. Maintain clear, concise, and regulator‑ready case documentation, ensuring investigations, rationale, and outcomes are fully recorded and retrievable for internal review, audit, or regulatory requests
• Regulatory Awareness and Standards Adherence. Stay up to date with UK MAR, FCA Market Watch publications, exchange rules (LME and ICE Futures Europe), and internal policies and procedures, ensuring surveillance activity aligns with regulatory expectations and industry best practice.
• Stakeholder Interaction. Engage proactively with Compliance, Risk, Front Office supervision, and (where applicable) outsourced surveillance teams, contributing to clear communication, consistent standards, and continuous improvement of the surveillance framework.
• General compliance support to derivative trading and clearing activities. Collaborate with the business, other departments and external counsels to ensure effective governance of the company’s futures business.
• Ad hoc tasks to support the Compliance function.
Requirements
• Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Law, Mathematics or Economics
• Minimum 3 years’ of relevant experience in financial services in Market Abuse Surveillance, preferably with demonstrable experience of the Commodities and financial derivative markets
• Demonstrable familiarity with surveillance systems such as Nasdaq SMARTS
• A working knowledge of the relevant regulations, FCA, Exchanges rules and industry practices applicable to futures and derivative trading and clearing activities
• Strong analytical and organisational skills
• Strong attention to details, proactive mindset and a team player
• Strong data handling skills
• Excellent communication skills both verbal and written

Job Description
The IT Asset Management Coordinator will be required to assist in the end-to-end oversight and deployment of IT hardware and software assets across their entire lifecycle. • Understanding of IT governance, security controls, and compliance requirements is desirable.

Author and revise SOPs, technical protocols, and reports while identifying opportunities to improve laboratory workflows, analytical reliability, and stability program execution.
• Uphold GMP compliance and data integrity: Execute laboratory and stability activities in accordance with applicable GxP regulations, internal policies, SOPs, and work instructions. Apply Good Documentation Practices and data integrity principles to ensure analytical results, electronic records, and supporting documentation are accurate, complete, traceable, and readily available for regulatory audits and inspections.

Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.
About the Hiring Team
Game Research Center(GRC) is a department focusing on game industry study, game analysis, game design research, data analysis and game development supporting. We’re one of the world’s leading research facility in game industry, building a global knowledge tank to help our teams make better decisions. We’re looking for innovative and passionate team members who love all kinds of games and have insight about the challenging global market.
What the Role Entails
This role sits within the GRC (Game Research Center) team. Its core mission is to bring in a highly authoritative game design leader with extensive hands-on development experience across global shooter, Games as a Service (GaaS), and PvP-focused titles.
We are looking for a true genre expert who can help define the next generation of gameplay standards. This individual will provide Tencent’s overseas portfolio with stronger strategic direction on product design trends, solve critical design challenges in active development, and identify opportunities for the next evergreen game franchise.
Key Responsibilities
1. Gameplay and Systems Design
• Define and refine best-in-class minute-to-minute gameplay experience, including controls, movement, and player feedback across visual, audio, and haptic layers.
• Build scalable and deeply engaging gameplay systems, including combat systems, character control, level interaction, mission flow, progression systems, and long-term engagement loops.
• Lead the design evaluation and strategic improvement of core gameplay pillars, including live service, 3C, combat/system design, level design, mission structure, world interaction, and player progression.
• Ensure systems are accessible, strategically deep, highly replayable, and fun over the long term.
2. Genre Expertise and Design Benchmarking
• Analyze leading global games in global shooter, casual competitive and RPG game genres, and turn those insights into reusable design frameworks.
• Set high-quality design benchmarks for core projects, including 3C, system interaction, and world exploration pacing.
3. Project Support and Evaluation
• Work directly with project teams to solve critical design problems, especially in GaaS systems, gameplay innovation, and economy balance.
• Review prototypes and milestone builds to ensure projects are both fun and distinctive in the global market.
• Provide hands-on design consultation to teams in development, with particular focus on high-priority shooter-related challenges, while also supporting selected opportunities in innovative casual and RPG projects.
• Help identify genre opportunities, product risks, and improvement areas early through expert review, structured feedback, and design modeling.
4. Industry Leadership
• Represent the company through thought leadership at industry events such as GDC, Devcom, and similar conferences.
• Use your industry reputation and network to connect with top global design talent and strengthen Tencent’s influence in game development.
Who We Look For
Experience
• 10+ years of experience in game design. with at least the past 5 years spent as a lead designer or core systems owner on globally recognized large-scale game projects.
• Proven success in shooter games, with strong practical experience in level design, 3C, combat design, and/or gameplay systems design.
• Strong industry recognition, ideally demonstrated through thought leadership and speaking engagements at major industry conferences or forums.
Core Skills
• Strong ability to design systems from the ground up that support long-term player engagement.
• Deep understanding of gameplay loops such as combat, progression, mission structure, exploration, social interaction, player creativity, and long-term retention.
• Strong expertise in 3C feel, including responsiveness, combat impact, camera, and audiovisual feedback.
• Strong understanding of hardcore players, competitive fairness, and player communities.
Soft Skills
• Fluent English, with the ability to work effectively with global development teams.
• Strong structured thinking: able to turn creative ideas into clear design documents and system models.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a practical and supportive approach.
Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

Your impact
At Leonardo, we solve real-world engineering challenges, designing and developing mission-critical solutions that power some of the world's most advanced defence and security systems.
We are recruiting for a Lead PCB Technical Specialist to provide deep technical leadership in the development, industrialisation and supply chain maturation of highly complex Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) within the UK European Common Radar System (ECRS) Mk2 programme. The role will report to the Project Engineering Lead for Supply Chain Improvement Team and support the Project Engineering Manager (PEM) and Programme Leadership Team in delivering the programme's technical, cost, quality and schedule objectives.
The successful candidate will act as the subject matter expert for PCB technologies, manufacturing processes and supplier capability development, supporting the transition of complex PCB designs from development through to high-yield, repeatable production. Working across engineering, manufacturing, quality and supply chain functions, the role will play a critical part in ensuring the programme can achieve its delivery commitments within an increasingly challenging electronic manufacturing supply landscape.
What you'll do as the Lead PCB Technical Specialist
You will play a major role in providing technical leadership and specialist guidance across all aspects of PCB manufacture, supplier development and product industrialisation.
As a Lead PCB Technical Specialist you will offer technical direction, evaluation, and recommendations relating to manufacturing risks and opportunities, while also defining strategic capability improvements and cost-reduction initiatives across the PCB supply chain to support long-term business objectives. You will:
•
Act as the technical lead for PCB manufacturing and industrialisation activities across the Mk2 Programme.
•
Own the technical strategy for the manufacture of highly complex PCB assemblies, ensuring designs are capable of achieving reliable, repeatable and cost-effective production.
•
Work closely with the Project Engineering Lead & Programme Manager to ensure cost and time trade-offs are undertaken and establish technical solutions coherent with agreed budgets and programme timescales.
•
Lead technical engagement with PCB manufacturers and key supply chain partners.
•
Conduct detailed assessments of supplier manufacturing capability, process maturity and technical risk.
•
Lead supplier development and supply chain maturity activities to improve manufacturing performance, quality, yield and capacity.
•
Identify manufacturing process weaknesses and drive corrective and preventive improvement initiatives within supplier organisations.
•
Ensure programme capacity, yield and cost targets are achieved in both the short and long term.
•
Provide Design for Manufacture (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) guidance to engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
•
Lead reviews of manufacturing readiness, production risk and technical compliance.
•
Communicate technical risks, issues and opportunities to the Project Chief Engineer and Programme Leadership Team.
•
Support configuration control, qualification, verification and acceptance activities associated with PCB production.
•
Represent Leonardo when engaging with customers, senior leadership and external stakeholders to define and deliver technical solutions.
What you'll bring
•
A minimum of 10 years' experience in PCB development, manufacture and industrialisation.
•
Extensive experience in the manufacture of highly complex multilayer and high-reliability PCB products.
•
Deep technical expertise in PCB fabrication, assembly and manufacturing technologies.
•
Proven experience of taking PCB products from development and low-yield production through to stable, high-yield manufacturing.
•
Strong understanding of PCB process capability, yield management and manufacturing quality systems.
•
Experience of identifying supplier process weaknesses and implementing effective improvement plans.
•
Experience working directly with PCB fabricators and assembly houses to resolve complex technical and manufacturing challenges.
•
Strong knowledge of DfM and DfA principles and their application to complex electronic products.
•
Experience leading supplier technical assessments, audits and manufacturing readiness reviews.
•
Understanding of capacity planning, supply chain resilience and manufacturing risk management.
This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

• Minimum Level 3 Level 3 qualification in Exercise Referral, Health Improvement/Promotion/Public Health, Nutrition & Weight Management, Coaching & Behaviour Change, or Education & Training.

• Experience facilitating groups and supporting individuals to achieve positive health, lifestyle, or behaviour changes.
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a person-centred and non-judgemental approach.
• Ability to engage and motivate people from diverse backgrounds and with varying levels of confidence and health literacy.

As a Vet you will be accountable for patient care within the clinic, whilst ensuring we deliver exceptional care, always there for our clients, patients and colleagues whilst maintaining the highest levels of regulatory and operational standards and compliance.
Veterinary Surgeon – Medivet Canonbury, Islington
Part-time 50–75% | Salary up to £65,000 FTE, pro rata depending on experience
We are looking for an experienced Veterinary Surgeon to join our friendly and growing team at Medivet Canonbury, in the heart of Islington.
The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience in small animal practice and a particular interest in one of the following areas: Small Animal Medicine, Feline Medicine, Dermatology or Ophthalmology.
The position would also be well suited to someone who holds, is working towards, or would like to pursue a relevant postgraduate certificate in their chosen area of interest.
Canonbury is an established and friendly first-opinion practice with a loyal client base and a varied caseload. We are currently a team of three vets, supported by two qualified nurses, two student veterinary nurses and three receptionists, creating a close-knit and collaborative environment.
Within the veterinary team, one of our vets holds a postgraduate certificate in Small Animal Surgery, while another is currently working towards a certificate in Diagnostic Imaging, with a particular interest in cardiology.
Our complementary clinical interests create plenty of opportunities for case discussion, collaboration and continued professional development.
The practice is well equipped, with in-house laboratory facilities, digital radiography and ultrasound, supporting a wide range of diagnostic investigations and allowing us to work up many cases in-house. We continue to invest in our equipment and develop the clinical services available at Canonbury.
Importantly, this is a non-surgical position. No surgical experience is required, and no routine surgery will be involved in your Canonbury shifts. The role will focus on consultations, medical case management and diagnostic work-ups, making it particularly suitable for a clinician who would like to concentrate on their chosen clinical interest.
We are looking for someone who enjoys providing high-quality first-opinion care, investigating cases thoroughly and building strong relationships with clients and their pets. There will be scope to develop your own clinical interests and contribute to the continued development of the services we offer at Canonbury.
The position is available at 50–75% of full-time hours, with some flexibility around the working pattern. As part of the role, there will be a requirement to undertake some weekend shifts at one of our hospital practices (approximately 1 in 12 or 1 in 9 weekends), depending on the contracted hours.
Located on Essex Road in Islington, Canonbury has excellent transport links and benefits from close collaboration with other practices and hospitals across the wider Medivet network.
If you are an experienced vet looking for a role where you can focus on consultations and medical case management without a routine surgical rota, while developing your own area of clinical interest, we would love to hear from you.

Quality Engineering is a vital transnational team within Airbus Commercial Aircraft. We ensure the highest quality assurance standards, driving the development of cutting-edge designs and technologies for both our new aircraft programs and existing product lines.
We collaborate closely with our engineering teams to ensure our products consistently meet all regulatory requirements, uphold stringent safety standards, and safeguard Airbus's global reputation.
An apprenticeship in Quality Engineering offers a unique opportunity to work across all Airbus Commercial Aircraft programs. You'll gain invaluable insights into the entire lifecycle of passenger aircraft, freighters, and private jets – from development and production to in-service processes. Being an engineering quality apprentice at Airbus means being part of a vibrant, supportive community. You will join an extensive apprentice network where you can share experiences and build lifelong professional connections. • Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP): A structured framework used to ensure quality is built into the product development process from concept to delivery.

Build a Quality Legacy at Hexcel
At Hexcel, quality is more than compliance. It is the foundation of products that enable the world's most advanced aerospace and industrial applications.
As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will have the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on our manufacturing operations, shaping processes, strengthening quality systems, and influencing the way we work across the business. This is an ideal opportunity for a quality or manufacturing professional who thrives in complex industrial environments and wants to apply their experience to drive meaningful improvements within a global leader in advanced composites technology.
Whether your background comes from aerospace, automotive, industrial manufacturing, assembly-line production, or other highly regulated sectors, this role offers the chance to bring proven skills, challenge existing thinking, and help create the next generation of manufacturing excellence at Hexcel.
With our strong investment in research and development and our culture of continuous improvement, Hexcel is the industry leader in the manufacturing of advanced lightweight composite materials, including carbon fibre, woven reinforcements, resins, prepregs, honeycombs, engineered core and composite structures. We invite you to join the Hexcel team at our Duxford site and become part of the "strength within."
About the Role
As Senior Quality Engineer, you will play a critical role in supporting quality excellence across manufacturing operations. Working closely with production, engineering, customers and suppliers, you will utilise your technical expertise and process mindset to identify opportunities for improvement, resolve complex quality issues, and ensure compliance within a large-scale composite manufacturing environment.
We're looking for someone who understands how manufacturing processes work from end-to-end, can identify risks and gaps before they become problems, and has the curiosity and analytical capability to investigate issues thoroughly and drive sustainable solutions.
Key Responsibilities
• Support internal, external and customer audits, ensuring compliance with QMS, regulatory and customer requirements.
• Lead and support non-conformance investigations, corrective actions and preventive improvement activities.
• Conduct robust root cause investigations and facilitate effective product and process issue resolution.
• Provide technical interpretation of specifications and quality requirements, supporting disposition decisions.
• Partner with manufacturing teams to improve process performance, product quality and operational efficiency.
• Monitor, analyse and interpret quality data and KPIs to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
• Apply quality tools and methodologies to resolve issues and strengthen manufacturing processes.
• Produce and maintain PPAP documentation where required.
• Manage customer quality communications in a professional and timely manner.
• Support supplier quality activities and audits where required.
• Identify better ways of working and contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of Hexcel's Quality Management System.
What We're Looking For
• Degree qualified in Engineering, Quality Management or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
• Proven experience within Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering or a similar role in manufacturing settings such as aerospace, automotive, advanced manufacturing, heavy engineering, assembly-line production or sheet metal fabrication.
• Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems, with experience working to AS9100, NADCAP or similar regulated standards.
• A deep understanding of manufacturing processes, process controls, inputs, outputs and quality assurance principles.
• Experience supporting audits, quality investigations, customer requirements and compliance activities.
• Knowledge of supplier quality management or supplier auditing would be advantageous.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interrogate data, identify trends and make evidence-based decisions.
• A naturally curious mindset with the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate multiple solutions and drive continuous improvement.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail.
Why Join Hexcel?
This is more than a quality role. It is an opportunity to apply your expertise to highly engineered composite material products, influence how manufacturing excellence is delivered, and make a tangible difference in a business that values innovation, continuous improvement and technical expertise. If you're a hands-on quality engineer with the depth of experience to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and strengthen quality performance, we'd like to hear from you!
Candidates must be eligible to work in the country where the position is based. Hexcel (NYSE: HXL) is a global leader in advanced composites technology, a leading producer of carbon fiber, and the world leader in honeycomb manufacturing for the commercial aerospace industry.

Linklaters is a global law firm, providing legal services in 20 countries and through 30 offices.
Linklaters is a people business. Being best in class in the eyes of our clients means that our people must be exceptional.
We look not only for brilliant minds, but for people who will thrive in our environment: people who love working collaboratively and demonstrate the innovative, efficient, agile, entrepreneurial, and responsible mind-set we aim to bring to every interaction.
Ours is an environment of outperformance. We achieve this not with targets and incentives, but by fostering a positive, supportive, fair, and open atmosphere.
We respect and value difference but insist on inclusivity. We celebrate all aspects of diversity and challenge any form of bias. This is vital to our ability to work as one team, with a common goal.
The Role
As a Revenue Advisor, you will be a trusted member of the Finance team, partnering with practice groups to optimise the Division’s revenue lifecycle and support strong financial performance. You will work closely with Partners, Matter Managers and Finance colleagues to manage WIP and debt profiles, support timely billing and help deliver billing targets. Acting as a key link between Finance and practice teams, you will provide practical guidance, resolve revenue-related issues and identify opportunities to improve billing, collections and overall revenue hygiene. This is a 12 month fixed-term position offering broad stakeholder exposure and opportunities to develop within a collaborative, globally connected Finance function.
Your Key Responsibilities:
• Partner with Partners, Matter Managers, Secretaries and Business Managers to proactively manage the revenue cycle, providing guidance on billing, WIP management, cash collection and overall financial outcomes.
• Build trusted relationships with matter teams, recommending best practice to improve fee management, cash flow and the financial performance of matters.
• Support Senior Revenue Advisors with practice-specific priorities and time-sensitive requirements, deputising where required to ensure continuity of financial guidance and support.
• Review Engagement Letters and matter-opening information to ensure alignment with client billing requirements, identifying and resolving potential issues early in the revenue cycle.
• Drive the resolution and collection of overdue debts, providing practical solutions to payment challenges and escalating sensitive or complex matters to the appropriate stakeholders.
• Manage e-billing rejections by liaising with client finance teams, investigating root causes and implementing preventative measures to minimise recurring issues.
• Maintain accurate WIP and debtor commentary, provide relevant financial reporting and insights, and support matter teams in identifying out-of-scope work and improving fee management processes.
• Provide guidance and training on client billing cycles and revenue best practice, while identifying and implementing opportunities to improve internal processes and the client experience from matter opening through to cash collection.
What we’re looking for:
• A minimum of two years’ experience within a professional services environment, with experience of managing the working capital cycle.
• Good knowledge of billing processes within a law firm or similar legal environment.
• Strong understanding of VAT requirements and associated CCO risks.
• Detailed knowledge of the Solicitors’ Accounts Rules and their application within a legal practice.
• Previous experience working within a legal practice, ideally within a leading law firm.
• A sound understanding of revenue management principles and how effective billing and working capital management contribute to financial performance.
What's on offer:
This role can be based in our London offices, with a hybrid working model available.

Finance
• Pension and flexible savings options

• Mortgage advice and will-writing services

About Us
Druck is a global leader in high‑precision pressure sensing technology. Our products operate in safety‑critical environments across aerospace, industrial, and energy sectors. We pride ourselves on delivering high‑integrity, high‑reliability solutions for customers around the world.
We are now expanding our aerospace software capability and are seeking an Embedded Software Test Engineer to support the verification and validation of safety‑critical embedded software developed to DO‑178C Level A.
Role Overview
In this role, you will be a key contributor to the software verification and validation lifecycle, ensuring our embedded systems meet the highest aerospace safety and quality standards. You will work closely with software, and hardware engineers to design, execute, and document verification activities in line with regulatory and customer requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Software Verification Activities
• Develop and execute test plans, test procedures, and test cases to support DO‑178C qualification.
• Ensure all tests provide clear traceability to high‑ and low‑level requirements.
• Perform unit, integration, hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL), and system‑level testing of embedded software.
• Conduct debugging, problem investigation, and defect reporting, working closely with the software development team.
• Produce clear and accurate test reports, evidence packages, and certification documentation.
Compliance & Quality
• Perform verification activities aligned with DO‑178C, DO‑330, and the company quality management system (AS9100).
• Participate in reviews of requirements, architecture, and code to assess testability and completeness.
• Support structural coverage activities (including MC/DC) where required.
Technical Contribution
• Interpret hardware datasheets, microcontroller documentation, and interface specifications to develop robust and realistic test scenarios.
• Work with embedded toolchains, debuggers, simulators, and automated test environments as needed.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of test processes, tools, and templates.
Required Skills & Experience
Essential
• Proven experience in software verification and validation in an aerospace or safety‑critical environment.
• Hands‑on experience applying DO‑178B/C practices, ideally to Level‑A.
• Strong understanding of embedded systems and experience testing microcontroller‑based software and low‑level communication protocols.

This role combines customer analysis, hands-on SQL data work, and driving customer audience strategy.

• Support business teams with testing suggestions and best practice
• Work with legal and IT security departments on setting up connectors between CDP and external partners when needed

• Troubleshoot data discrepancies across CDP, source systems and reporting outputs
• Drive best practices in data handling, documentation, and query structuring

• Communicate insights in a clear, actionable way (non-technical audience friendly)
• Act as a key link between data, analytics, and marketing execution

• Someone who can own end-to-end delivery: from gathering requirements → insight → presenting results → creating audience → evaluation of results
• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to working with data
• A proactive individual who can work independently and manage multiple priorities
• A clear communicator who can simplify complex data for business stakeholders
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively across teams

• Strong hands-on experience using SQL to query, manipulate and validate large datasets (this is essential)
• Advanced power point skills
• Advanced Excel skills
• Hands-on experience creating customer segments / audiences for campaigns
• Excellent attention to detail, with a strong focus on data accuracy and governance

Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.

To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.

Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
Our Industrial Placement Programme
Our Industrial Placement Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive a salary of £26,228, with coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.
Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme.
During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. This Opportunity is based in Luton.
What You'll Do
As an Industrial Placement Antenna Engineer, you'll join a team delivering world-leading Electronic Warfare capabilities that protect fast jets, UAVs, naval vessels and land platforms operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
As part of our Antenna Engineering team, you'll support the development of high-performance antenna systems used within advanced Electronic Warfare solutions.
Your activities will include:
• Supporting the design and development of innovative antenna solutions for a range of defence platforms
• Using electromagnetic (EM) simulation tools to model and analyse antenna performance
• Supporting the development of antenna technologies operating at frequencies up to 40GHz and beyond
• Conducting laboratory testing, measurement and validation using specialist RF equipment and anechoic chamber facilities
• Analysing technical data and presenting findings to engineering teams and stakeholders
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to integrate antenna solutions into larger systems
• Contributing to technical documentation, design reviews and customer deliverables
Your Industrial Placement Project
Approximately 50% of your placement will be dedicated to a cohort-led Industrial Placement project. Working alongside other placement students from different engineering disciplines, you'll define, manage and deliver a substantial project from concept through to final presentation.
This experience will help you develop project management, leadership, teamwork and stakeholder engagement skills alongside your technical development.
What We're Looking For
• You should be studying towards a degree in:
• Electronic Engineering
• Electrical Engineering
• Physics or Applied Physics
• Engineering Physics
• Mathematics or Applied Mathematics
• Communications Engineering
• Space Engineering
• Robotics Engineering
• Computer Communication and Networks
• Cyber Security or related STEM disciplines
We'd also like to see:
• An interest in electromagnetics, RF systems, antenna design or communication systems
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong communication and teamwork skills
• A willingness to learn and take ownership of challenging tasks
The Placement Experience
You'll benefit from:
• Hands-on experience on real engineering projects
• Mentoring from experienced engineers
• Technical and professional skills development
• A dedicated Industrial Placement cohort project
• Exposure to multiple engineering disciplines and technologies
• Opportunities to build your professional network across Leonardo
Security Clearance
Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting
Why join us
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, our teams are key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.
• Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
• Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
• Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity.
• Tailored perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
For a full list of our company benefits please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/company-benefits

We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people, communities and our customers. If you have any accessibility requirements to support you during the recruitment process, just let us know.
